name: 7-Zip
summary: The 7-Zip File Manager runs through Wine; note that Lindos already extracts 7z/zip/rar natively.
notes:
7-Zip installs and runs through Wine without extra runtimes: the 7-Zip File Manager (7zFM.exe) browses your files under Z:\ (that is your Linux home) and creates/extracts 7z, zip, tar, gz, xz, rar (extract only) archives. Use the 64-bit installer (7zNNNN-x64.exe). What does not carry over: the Windows Explorer context menu ('7-Zip > Extract here') - Linux file managers have their own.
You probably do not need it: Lindos already opens 7z/zip/rar/tar archives natively - right-click an archive in the file manager > 'Extract Here' (Engrampa/File Roller with the p7zip back end), and the '7z' command is available in the terminal (apt install 7zip). The Wine build is only useful if you rely on a Windows-only 7-Zip feature or a plug-in.
This recipe creates a 64-bit C:\ drive with no special tweaks.
